notes: Tender perennial — winter-kill below 15 °F. Container or high-tunnel in Mid-Atlantic.

preserving.note: Herbs in oil can grow Clostridium botulinum. Follow a tested method: keep oil infused with unacidified herbs in the refrigerator and discard it 4 days after making it, or acidify the herbs first exactly as UGA Extension Circular 1334 describes.

careTasks.title: Pruning the plants will encourage a tight compact habit.
The tender tips and foliage can be cut as needed throughout the growing season.

seasonalTasks.title: Prune rosemary after it blooms
seasonalTasks.body: Once the plants finish blooming, you can prune them back to encourage dense, leafy growth.
